items.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
items.summary: China's economic slowdown worsened in October with retail sales, investment and industrial output all missing economists' estimates, as analysts warn a growing reliance on external demand leaves growth more exposed to shocks abroad.

items.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
items.summary: The largest technology stocks linked to the artificial intelligence trade could stand to benefit the most from Nvidia's woes and a Democratic-controlled Congress pushing back on data centers, according to investing experts interviewed on CNBC's " ETF Edge " earlier this week.

items.title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
items.summary: Foundation Future Industries , a maker of military humanoid robots advised and backed by Eric Trump, failed to pay employees last month as its cash reserves dwindled, according to people with direct knowledge of the matter.

items.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
items.summary: In late September, Cantor Fitzgerald hosted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and other top executives from the chipmaker for investor meetings in New York, according to a Cantor research report reviewed by CNBC.

items.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
items.summary: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter, shrinking at an annualized 0.1% compared to the previous quarter, as elevated energy prices weighed on consumption and net exports.
